name: com.mailpace/mailpace-mcp
title: MailPace
description: Send transactional email and manage MailPace domains from MCP clients.

environmentVariables.name: MAILPACE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Domain API token for sending email and domain-scoped status lookups.

environmentVariables.name: MAILPACE_ORGANIZATION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Organization API token for domain and domain API token management.

environmentVariables.name: MAILPACE_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated recipient allowlist of exact addresses or @domain rules.

environmentVariables.name: MAILPACE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

environmentVariables.name: MAILPACE_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Optional retry count for idempotent requests and 429 responses. Defaults to 2.
